expected: Of Cooper Flats' 5 threshold-crossing days, 3 fell during a documented low-reliability sensor window (days 8-14, reliability 62%) and were correctly routed to manual review rather than auto-alerted, per policy. The remaining 2 crossings occurred outside that window, when the sensor was reliable (97%), and only 1 of those 2 received an advisory. This leaves one specific, policy-noncompliant missed advisory for Cooper Flats that is not explained by the sensor issue -- a real, if narrow, fairness gap, distinct from the sensor-reliability-driven gap, which was itself policy-compliant.
